title: kbingest names_clone_code drops a drive-less rooted Windows path, and tools.md and hosting.md state stale facts about kbingest and kb_http
goal: kbingest.names_clone_code exempts a drive-less rooted path on nt (HOMEPATH, \Users\x) as the docs promise, with a test named names_clone_code_drive_less_rooted that plants HOMEPATH through ntpath; the tools.md kbingest map row lists registry.credential-provider, registries.<name>.credential-provider, global-credential-providers and doc.browser; kb_http.py and hosting.md say the framing allowance binds at about 4.1 KiB (CHUNK_SLACK), not 8 KiB. Found by the SP-7irdeeel review (D2, D3 and a stale statement).
repro_reason: the Windows path case needs ntpath semantics that a repro on this Mac cannot run; the text match shows no drive-less rooted exemption
